استجرتن (form X)
# اِسْتَجَرْتُنَّ (istajartunna) /is.ta.d͡ʒar.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past active of اِسْتَجَارَ (istajāra)
# اُسْتُجِرْتُنَّ (ustujirtunna) /us.tu.d͡ʒir.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past passive of اِسْتَجَارَ (istajāra)
